correctness.rationale: Guo--Xu--Zhang prove the exact mirror map, the pole form F_g=(-1)^{g-1}P_g/Delta^{5g-5}, and the all-genus nonzero value of P_g at the critical point. Solving Delta for q gives Q/Q_c=(1-Delta)(1-Delta/p^2)^{-p^2}, whose linear term cancels and whose first defect is ((p^2-1)/(2p^2))Delta^2. Hence the pole of order 5g-5 becomes an algebraic singularity of exponent (5g-5)/2 in Q. Standard transfer gives the coefficient power (5g-7)/2 and the displayed Gamma factor. Direct exponent arithmetic gives the stated p- and (p^2-1)-powers. The positive psi-class intersection makes the leading constant nonzero.

originality.rationale: The asymptotic exponent and qualitative fixed-genus local-curve behavior were predicted in earlier physics/resurgence work, so they are not claimed as new predictions. The new theorem is the rigorous all-genus consequence enabled by the 2026 proof of the higher-genus ansatz and double-scaling coefficient. The 2007 source explicitly treated the critical all-genus value as conjectural, while the 2016/2017 resurgence paper used finite-genus data and numerical large-degree analysis. No inspected source gave a proof for every finite p>=2 and every g>=2 with the exact tautological prefactor.
residual_risks: Because the asymptotic was explicitly predicted before 2026, the originality claim is confined to a rigorous all-genus proof with the exact tautological prefactor, not to the exponent or qualitative growth law.

An unindexed analytic-combinatorics argument may have previously converted the conjectural ansatz into a conditional coefficient statement, but such a conditional statement would still not supply the now-unconditional all-genus premise.

The transfer theorem is standard; the scientific content rests on verifying that the principal mirror branch has the stated unique dominant square-root singularity and that the critical numerator is nonzero.

value.rationale: Large-degree growth of Gromov--Witten invariants is a central enumerative asymptotic question, and this local-curve family has had an explicit physics/resurgence prediction for roughly two decades. The finding converts the newly proved all-genus critical behavior into a theorem about the actual A-model degree coefficients, giving the exact exponential growth rate, algebraic power, sign, convergence radius, and tautological leading constant for every finite p>=2 and g>=2. This closes a natural theorem-versus-prediction gap rather than adding an arbitrary numerical specialization.
